items.text: Empty Mirror
Kakania stares through the doorway that Lucy left open.
The echos of their conversation are swimming in her mind.
"You cannot, or you do not want to?"
"Both. I can neither use my arcane skill nor do I want to."
"I can't control it, but, Isolde ..."

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Isolde ...

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: I'm the only one who can help her.
"I'm the only one who can help her, aren't I?"
"Then ..."
"Just this once, I will try my best."

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: I will ...
She bows her head.
Relax. It's just an arcane skill. Like you've cast countless times before.
It's the arcane skill passed down to you through the Vingler family—look into the mirror, and it will reflect whatever is on your mind.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: *exhale*

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Tell me.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Um ...
It feels like a lifetime since she last cast her arcane skill. There's nothing in the mirror. It's as blank as her mind.
She doesn't even know what question to ask.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: For crying out loud! What am I doing?!

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: This is ridiculous. It's not even a full mirror!

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: How can I do anything with such a small fragment?!

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Such a small fragment.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Fragment ...

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: I need a new mirror. Something bigger and newer than this one, like, umm.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: A hand mirror?
Before she knows it, the shard in her hand has transformed itself into a hand mirror.
It's clear and familiar, but much too light.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Hmm?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: This is ...
At this moment, she realizes that the mirror in her hand is simply an illusion. It plunges her into a fragment of her memory.
Welcome, my friend.
Here, this gift is for you.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Oh, no, I couldn't possibly take this. I haven't done anything to deserve such a valuable gift.
Shh.
It's because of your help that I can now walk with you along the river! That arcanum license, though a forgery, is quite valuable to me.
So, please accept it. I'll be glad to be free from its whispers.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Wait, it can talk? Zemfira, don't tell me you pulled this out of some ancient tomb or something!

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: Heh-heh. Take it, and then I'll tell you.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: You know, a hand mirror wouldn't be my first choice.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: The mirrors I use in my treatments can generally be placed independently, either on a table or the ground. This reduces the risk of them breaking during the session.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: It's a safety measure. Just to be sure.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: So, you see, I wouldn't know what to do with this, despite my desire to hear the story behind it. I always prefer table or full-length mirrors.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: They're safer, easier to place, and more convenient for patients.

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: I understand, my friend.

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: You're saying that this hand mirror is merely a gaudy plaything rather than a useful tool.

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: But when people first created the hand mirror, they were looking for simplicity and convenience.

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: In the end, though, they became rather meretricious. Attractive in appearance, yes. But of little practical use.

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: Just like arcanists, isn't it?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: I beg to differ.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Arcanists aren't like that at all. We have much to offer the world.

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: Then you should take it.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: What?

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: Your arcane skill, so intriguing, yet horrifying. People, more than anything, fear their true desires being revealed.

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: So you need a container to hold all those overwhelming desires.

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: I know, I know. You already have two or three mirrors that are much wider and taller than this one.

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: But to have so many mirrors and not a single one to be held in the hand?

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: Well, the collection is incomplete, is it not?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Not at all. It simply isn't necessary.

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: You don't have a hand mirror, how can that be? My friend, you simply must have a mirror.

items.speaker: Zemfira
items.text: A hand mirror for yourself.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Well ...

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Alright, I'll take it. Thank you, Zemfira.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Oh my, it's heavy. Has this been painted with tempera? And I must say, I don't recognize any of these patterns.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Well, here it is. My very first hand mirror! A heavy, well-decorated, expensive medium for my treatment. Better put it away carefully.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Actually, yes! I've made up my mind! I'll take it back and show it to everyone. I wonder what Elbert will say after I so vehemently refused to get a hand mirror all this time.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Now, Zemfira, would you please tell me the story of this mirror?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Hm?
She looks around. There isn't a single person to be seen.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Zemfira? Where are you?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Where did you go?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Where's the mirror? Where's Zemfira?
You've come to the right man, Doctor.
Zemfira set off for the Caucasus some time ago. Didn't she tell you she was going?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: She ... Wait, Illich?
I heard she gifted you a talking mirror. Then, I'm sure you'll be interested in this, too.
It's a talking porcelain basin! If you wipe it down, fill it with clean water, and light it just right,
you can use it as a mirror as well!

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: I'm sorry. What are you talking about?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Or, rather, why are you here?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: In the Foundation?
Unable to answer such questions, the illusion is broken. It fades away, along with the mirror in her hand.
Slowly regaining control of her mind and body, Kakania returns to the ward once again.
She knows this will happen again. It's only a matter of time. All she can do is ...

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: *exhale*
There's a file on the table. The Foundation has clearly expressed their requirements and suggestions within it, much like Lucy has told her.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Help ...
As she scans through the file, Kakania comes to a decision.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Yes, I need their help.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: To help her. To regain control of my arcane skill.
She presses the intercom button above her bedstand.

items.speaker: Operator
items.text: Laplace Rehabilitation Center, how may I help you?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: This is Klara Vingler.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: I agree to appear in court as a witness of the incident, and I will support the study of this "Storm."

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: And I will also attend therapy.

items.speaker: Operator
items.text: I see. Please stay on the line.

items.speaker: Operator
items.text: We'll reroute you to our specialist to make the necessary arrangements.
